pages.title: Modular Arithmetic
pages.text: $(thing)Modular Arithmetic$()$(br2)Arithmetic on a clock: 9 + 5 is 2 on a twelve-hour dial. Fermat and Euler found its rules, and every cipher that keeps a secret on the open internet runs on them.

$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Primes.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Prime Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): p and q are two different primes. Write φ, how many numbers below pq share no factor with pq.
